item.title: Kohli passes 15,000 ODI runs as India beat West Indies
item.description: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to reach 15,000 ODI runs, achieving the milestone with an unbeaten century as India cruised to an eight-wicket victory over West Indies in the opening one-day international on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to reach 15,000 ODI runs, achieving the milestone with an unbeaten century as India cruised to an eight-wicket victory over West Indies in the opening one-day international on Sunday. Kohli struck 139 not out from 88 balls and Shubman Gill made 110 as India chased down 296 with 50 balls to spare to take a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Rohit Sharma and Gill launched the chase with a 74-run opening stand before Sharma was dismissed in the 12th over. Gill, the world's top-ranked ODI batter, then took control, maintaining the aggressive approach and bringing up his 10th ODI century with a sweep. Kohli came in at number three and notched his 86th international century, while Gill struck 110 from 108 deliveries as the pair put on a dominant 151-run stand off 132 balls that all but sealed the contest. Roston Chase eventually removed Gill, but Ruturaj Gaikwad made 13 off 19 balls and helped Kohli steer India home without further alarm. Kohli sealed victory with successive boundaries. Put in to bat, Justin Greaves and John Campbell gave West Indies a strong start, adding 135 from 117 balls for the opening wicket. India struggled to find a breakthrough for much of the first 20 overs as the pair dominated the bowling and provided a solid platform. Greaves, who was dropped by Sharma on 16, made India pay with a maiden ODI century and top-scored for the visitors. The momentum shifted when Kuldeep Yadav dismissed Campbell in the 20th over, beating him in the air as he swept a catch to short fine leg. Yadav and Prasidh Krishna then applied the brakes as West Indies lost four wickets for 22 runs between the 31st and 36th overs. Yadav finished with 4-40 on his ODI return but Amir Jangoo counter-attacked with 58 off 43 balls. With support from Chase, he helped West Indies recover from 198-5 and post 295.

item.title: Aces star A'ja Wilson named AP WNBA Player of Year
item.description: Las Vegas Aces superstar center A'ja Wilson won The Associated Press' WNBA Player of the Year award for an unprecedented third consecutive season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Aces superstar center A'ja Wilson won The Associated Press' WNBA Player of the Year award for an unprecedented third consecutive season. Wilson, 30, received 15 of the 17 first-place votes from a national media panel Sunday. She topped Minnesota Lynx rookie guard Olivia Miles as well as guards Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell of the Indiana Fever. It marked the fourth time that Wilson has won the award, snapping a tie with New York Liberty star Breanna Stewart for the most in WNBA history since it was distributed starting in 2016. Wilson is bidding to be named WNBA MVP for the third straight season and fifth time overall. She recorded a league-best 26.2 points per game to go with 9.4 rebounds and a career-best 3.2 assists per game. Atlanta Dream forward Angel Reese, however, prevented Wilson from repeating as AP's Defensive Player of the Year. Reese contributed 16.4 points and 12.1 rebounds per game this season. Miles was a unanimous choice for Rookie of the Year. The second overall pick in this year's draft averaged 19.8 points, 6.0 assists and 4.7 per game at Minnesota finished with the league's best record. She broke Clark's rookie scoring record in the final week of the regular season. Clark was named the AP's Comeback Player of the Year. She averaged 22.3 points and 8.3 assists per contest this season. Other winners included Minnesota Lynx head coach Cheryl Reeve (Coach of the Year), Dallas Wings forward Jessica Shepard (Most Improved Player) and Golden State Valkyries forward Janelle Salaun (Sixth Woman of the Year). --Field Level Media

item.title: Des frappes russes tuent trois personnes dans des villes ukrainiennes - autorités
item.description: Des attaques russes ont fait trois morts dimanche dans deux villes ukrainiennes et ont touché la capitale Kyiv, ont indiqué les autorités locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des attaques russes ont fait trois morts dimanche dans deux villes ukrainiennes et ont touché la capitale Kyiv, ont indiqué les autorités locales. Dans la ville de Soumy, au nord-est pays, fréquemment prise pour cible en raison de sa localisation près de la frontière, trois bombes sont tombées à proximité d'un centre d'aide aux familles, tuant deux personnes, écrit le gouverneur régional sur la messagerie Telegram. La Russie ne cache pas son intention de transformer certaines parties de la région de Soumy en zone tampon. À Kharkiv, deuxième ville d'Ukraine, également dans le nord-est et également souvent prise pour cible, un drone a touché une voiture, tuant le conducteur, ont indiqué les procureurs. À Kyiv, le maire Vitali Klitschko a rapporté qu'un drone avait frappé un immeuble d'habitation de grande hauteur et provoqué un incendie dans une banlieue est, blessant une personne.

item.title: Trump diz que homens presos em base aérea dos EUA no Reino Unido pretendiam causar “grandes danos”
item.description: A polícia britânica prendeu cinco homens nas proximidades de uma base aérea dos EUA sob suspeita de crimes relacionados a explosivos e terrorismo neste domingo, após uma denúncia de que três vans se dirigiam ao aeródromo militar, que tem sido utilizado para ataques contra o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Toby Shepheard
item.content:encoded: A polícia britânica prendeu cinco homens nas proximidades de uma base aérea dos EUA sob suspeita de crimes relacionados a explosivos e terrorismo neste domingo, após uma denúncia de que três vans se dirigiam ao aeródromo militar, que tem sido utilizado para ataques contra o Irã. O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou que os suspeitos pretendiam causar “grandes danos” e já estavam sob investigação conduzida por autoridades britânicas e norte-americanas. Detetives britânicos especializados em contraterrorismo, que lideram a investigação, informaram que a polícia recebeu uma denúncia sobre três veículos suspeitos que pareciam estar se dirigindo para a RAF Fairford, no oeste da Inglaterra, na madrugada deste domingo. Cinco homens foram detidos por policiais armados e, posteriormente, mantidos em custódia sob suspeita de preparação de ato terrorista. A polícia acredita que o incidente já está sob controle. “Estamos nos estágios iniciais da investigação, e cinco homens continuam sob custódia”, afirmou a coordenadora nacional sênior da Polícia Antiterrorista, Vicki Evans, em comunicado. “Como era de se esperar, estamos trabalhando em estreita colaboração com nossos parceiros para entender as circunstâncias do incidente.” A polícia informou que um perímetro de segurança de 400 metros foi estabelecido ao redor da base enquanto a equipe de desativação de bombas investigava as vans. Moradores de 85 residências em um vilarejo próximo foram retirados, e policiais armados patrulhavam o local. O governo britânico autorizou os EUA a usar bombardeiros baseados em Fairford para atacar instalações de mísseis iranianas usadas para atingir navios no Estreito de Ormuz. O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, agradeceu à polícia e às Forças Armadas, afirmando no X: “Sei que o incidente de hoje perto da RAF Fairford será motivo de grande preocupação para os moradores locais e para muitas pessoas que acompanham os desdobramentos em todo o país”. O Reino Unido declarou em julho que suas Forças Armadas estavam prontas para proteger o país de qualquer ataque após a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã advertir o país a não permitir que bombardeiros dos EUA decolassem de Fairford, afirmando que qualquer base usada para lançar ataques tornaria-se um alvo legítimo. A polícia não revelou quem acredita estar envolvido no suposto incidente deste domingo. Um motivo relacionado ao Irã é considerado o mais provável, disse uma fonte familiarizada com a investigação, enquanto uma operação de sabotagem russa ou uma conspiração islâmica também estão sendo investigadas. “A prisão no Reino Unido foi fantástica”, disse Trump a jornalistas, afirmando que foi “um trabalho incrível”. “Estávamos investigando esses indivíduos. Eles pretendiam causar grandes danos ao nosso porto, e a cooperação com os britânicos funcionou muito bem... Estávamos de olho neles há muito tempo e conseguimos prendê-los”, acrescentou Trump. Na manhã deste domingo, a base foi bloqueada por policiais armados, enquanto máquinas pesadas também impediam o acesso; testemunhas da Reuters afirmaram que a segurança foi reforçada em outras bases utilizadas pelos EUA, com veículos blindados e soldados nos portões da RAF Lakenheath e da RAF Mildenhall, no leste da Inglaterra. Ministros britânicos já haviam informado provedores de infraestrutura crítica sobre a ameaça representada pela Rússia, com o governo cada vez mais preocupado com possíveis operações de sabotagem e ataques cibernéticos. A Rússia nega estar realizando ataques híbridos contra nações ocidentais. Uma base aérea militar britânica no centro da Inglaterra foi invadida em junho de 2025 pelo grupo de protesto Palestine Action, que desde então foi considerado uma organização terrorista.

item.title: Hezbollah plans to contribute to project to house thousands of Lebanese displaced, chief says
item.description: Iran-backed Lebanese group Hezbollah said on Sunday it would contribute soon to a project aimed at housing thousands of people displaced due to the war with Israel.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran-backed Lebanese group Hezbollah said on Sunday it would contribute soon to a project aimed at housing thousands of people displaced due to the war with Israel . The announcement was made by Hezbollah chief Naim Qassem during a speech [USN:L2N3VE054 TEXT:"commemorating the second anniversary"] of leader Hassan Nasrallah's killing by Israel in 2024 "The party (Hezbollah) is committed to providing shelter, restoration, and reconstruction with the available resources and donations. The details of a new housing project for residents of villages that were completely destroyed will be announced very soon," Qassem said Qassem said the Lebanese state should have taken responsibility regarding sheltering and compensating the displaced "It is still their duty to fulfil their responsibility regarding shelter, compensation, and all obligations related to reconstruction and restoration," he said More than one million people, representing nearly a quarter of Lebanon's population, were displaced after a new war erupted between Israel's military and Hezbollah in early March Most have returned to their homes, but more than 340,000 remain displaced because their towns were destroyed or fall within areas [USN:S0N3ZO00S TEXT:"occupied"] by the Israeli military Since March 2, Israeli strikes have killed more than 4,300 people in Lebanon, including more than 250 children, and wounded another 12,000, including 1,000 children

item.title: Le PM britannique Andy Burnham refuse de soutenir le projet de troisième piste à Heathrow
item.description: Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham a refusé dimanche d'apporter son soutien au projet de construction d'une troisième piste à Heathrow, estimant que cette décision était du ressort des habitants vivant à proximité du principal aéroport de Londres et premier d'Europe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham a refusé dimanche d'apporter son soutien au projet de construction d'une troisième piste à Heathrow, estimant que cette décision était du ressort des habitants vivant à proximité du principal aéroport de Londres et premier d'Europe. Il prend ainsi le contre-pied de son prédécesseur Keir Starmer, qui avait dit l'an dernier qu'il soutenait le projet d'extension de Heathrow. "Je pense que, fondamentalement, c'est une question qui concerne Londres", a déclaré Andy Burnham lors d'une interview à la BBC donnée au début du congrès annuel du Parti travailliste. "Je pense qu'il faut d'abord écouter l'avis des habitants de la région. Il ne serait pas juste de ma part de me prononcer trop vite, avant même la fin de la consultation", a-t-il ajouté. Au cours du week-end l'aéroport d'Heathrow a déclaré que l'ouverture d'une troisième piste - projet qui divise les responsables politiques depuis deux décennies - pourrait être retardée de quatre ans, soit une ouverture, en cas du lancement du chantier, au plus tôt en 2039. L'aéroport fonctionne actuellement à 99% de ses capacités et risque d'être dépassé en Europe par d'autres aéroports. Ses deux pistes sont à comparer aux quatre pistes de l'aéroport Charles-de-Gaulle à Paris et de l'aéroport de Francfort et aux six pistes de l'aéroport Schiphol d'Amsterdam.

item.title: Miller and Bavuma bash Australia as South Africa win ODI series
item.description: Temba Bavuma and David Miller both struck centuries as South Africa defeated Australia by 32 runs in a high-scoring second one-day international in Johannesburg on Sunday to claim the three-match series with a game to spare.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Temba Bavuma and David Miller both struck centuries as South Africa defeated Australia by 32 runs in a high-scoring second one-day international in Johannesburg on Sunday to claim the three-match series with a game to spare. Australia sent their hosts in to bat and South Africa amassed 365 for nine in their 50 overs, before bowling the visitors out for 333 in 49.5 overs as they continued their dominance over their rivals with a 19th ODI win in their last 25 meetings. Australia were again undone by spin in the middle of the innings after a fast start to their reply and were not helped by the continued absence of seamer Pat Cummins and a side strain suffered by Nathan Ellis in the match that meant he bowled only four overs. "It's really disappointing," Australia captain Mitch Marsh said. "We came here determined to level the series at 1-1 and take it into the final game but fair play to South Africa. I thought they played really well and outplayed us again. "We just want to keep improving. We certainly don't want to be whitewashed, so we'll go to Potchefstroom determined to win that final game and play some good cricket." Bavuma scored his 103 from 116 balls for his sixth ODI century, while Miller was more explosive, with nine sixes in his 142 from 93 balls, clearing the ropes with ease as he struck his career-best score and eighth ODI ton. Jack Edwards, playing in his second ODI, was the pick of the Australia bowlers with 5-67 in 10 overs. In a carbon copy of Thursday’s 67-run win for South Africa in Durban, Australia made a lightning start to their reply as Marsh (84 from 53 balls) and Travis Head (84 from 76 balls) put on 130 in 17 overs for the first wicket. But the middle order struggled and South Africa’s three spinners tightened the screw. Keshav Maharaj (2-54), Bjorn Fortuin (2-70) and Aiden Markram (1-55) were all effective in their 10 overs. Xavier Bartlett kept Australia in the game with a fine 50 runs from 28 deliveries. "It was another really good all-round team performance," Bavuma said. "It started with the bat. Conditions were a little tricky up front but we managed to get through that period and build towards a good total. "David played an unbelievable innings and then the bowlers did their job as well." The final match is in Potchefstroom on Wednesday.

item.title: England rout Sri Lanka by 223 runs to win ODI series
item.description: England’s Tom Banton struck a first One Day International century before England’s bowlers romped through the Sri Lanka line-up to ensure a 2-1 series victory, winning the deciding clash by an imposing 223 runs at The Oval on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England’s Tom Banton struck a first One Day International century before England’s bowlers romped through the Sri Lanka line-up to ensure a 2-1 series victory, winning the deciding clash by an imposing 223 runs at The Oval on Sunday. Banton scored 126 after England chose to bat and laid the foundation for a formidable total of 355-7 before dismissing Sri Lanka for a modest 132. Banton’s innings, which highlighted his expansive range of shots, included 5 sixes and 16 fours as he mercilessly took to the visiting bowling after fellow opener Ben Duckett had been castled in the second over. England captain Harry Brook, who was dropped when he had seven runs, punished Sri Lanka’s poor fielding display with 77 off 66 balls while Jordan Cox, replacing the injured Jos Buttler, made 76 from 52 balls on his return to the ODI side for the first time in almost two years. "I thought it was a near perfect performance with everyone chipping in beautifully," said Brook. England had won the first ODI at Chester-le-Street on Tuesday by 89 runs but lost by 16 runs in Leeds two days later, setting up Sunday’s deciding tie which turned into a one-sided contest with Sri Lanka bowled out in 29.1 overs. Sonny Baker took two balls on his second ODI appearance, one year after his debut, to snag the wicket of Pathum Nissanka, who touched one behind to wicketkeeper Cox, beginning a steady stream of dismissals. Six of the seven bowlers that England used got among the wickets, with Liam Dawson finishing with 3-26 in eight overs and Gus Atkinson taking 2-26 from five overs. Captain Kusal Mendis, who scored a ton in the second ODI, top-scored for the visitors with 36 as Sri Lanka never looked like being able to chase down the imposing target. “I think we've only lost two white ball games all summer, so this group's doing incredibly well, improving, learning all the time, and moving in the right direction with the World Cup around the corner,” said Joe Root after picking up an award as England’s best ODI player of the summer. “I think we're trending in a really good way so long may that continue, and that hunger stays there, and we can keep winning match-winning performances and series wins before that comes round,” he added.

item.title: Des inondations et des glissements de terrain ont fait 56 morts en Inde et 14 au Népal
item.description: Cinquante six personnes ont trouve la mort en Inde et 14 au Népal à la suite de fortes pluies et d'orages qui ont provoqué des inondations et des glissements de terrain, ont déclaré les autorités, ajoutant que d'autres crues soudaines étaient à craindre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cinquante six personnes ont trouve la mort en Inde et 14 au Népal à la suite de fortes pluies et d'orages qui ont provoqué des inondations et des glissements de terrain, ont déclaré les autorités, ajoutant que d'autres crues soudaines étaient à craindre. Au Népal, 11 personnes sont également portées disparues. [USN:L8N44N0I6 TEXT:"Fin août"], 1.399 personnes ont été tuées dans des crues dévastatrices qui ont fait plus de 5.400 disparus au Népal et au Tibet. Parmi ce bilan, la Chine fait état de 43 morts et 519 disparus.

item.title: Coreia do Sul lamenta rejeição da Ucrânia a acordo sobre prisioneiros norte-coreanos
item.description: A Presidência da Coreia do Sul expressou neste domingo “profundo pesar” pelo que descreveu como a negativa, por parte da Ucrânia, a um acordo com Seul para não divulgar a transferência de dois prisioneiros de guerra norte-coreanos para a Coreia do Sul, informou a agência de notícias Yonhap.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Presidência da Coreia do Sul expressou neste domingo “profundo pesar” pelo que descreveu como a negativa, por parte da Ucrânia, a um acordo com Seul para não divulgar a transferência de dois prisioneiros de guerra norte-coreanos para a Coreia do Sul, informou a agência de notícias Yonhap. O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, disse na quarta-feira à Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas que a Ucrânia havia transferido dois soldados norte-coreanos capturados para a Coreia do Sul. Ele afirmou que os homens haviam sido enviados para lá recentemente, após serem capturados enquanto lutavam pela Rússia na guerra contra a Ucrânia. O presidente sul-coreano Lee Jae Myung afirmou posteriormente que era “profundamente lamentável” que a Ucrânia tivesse tornado pública a transferência, acrescentando que as duas partes haviam concordado em não divulgá-la. A Presidência “manifesta profundo pesar pela divulgação unilateral da Ucrânia (da transferência) e pelo subsequente anúncio falso de que não havia um acordo de confidencialidade”, afirmou Seong Ghi-hong, secretário sênior da Presidência para relações públicas, em comunicado citado pela Yonhap. A autoridade sul-coreana acrescentou que o governo estava considerando medidas adicionais sobre a questão, se necessário, completou a Yonhap. A Ucrânia capturou os dois norte-coreanos na região de Kursk, na Rússia, em janeiro de 2025. Eles foram os primeiros soldados norte-coreanos a serem capturados vivos desde que Pyongyang entrou na guerra entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia, em 2024. A transferência ocorre no momento em que a Coreia do Sul tem apoiado esforços para retomar o diálogo com a Coreia do Norte, enquanto o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, renovou sua disposição de dialogar com Pyongyang.

item.title: Parma part ways with manager Carlos Cuesta
item.description: Carlos Cuesta has left his role as Parma manager, the Serie A club said in a statement on Sunday, describing the move as a "shared decision."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Carlos Cuesta has left his role as Parma manager, the Serie A club said in a statement on Sunday, describing the move as a "shared decision." Following discussions between the club and the manager, "it was agreed that the conditions no longer existed between the parties to continue the professional relationship, particularly concerning the development of the sporting project," the statement said. The 31-year-old Spaniard, who was previously assistant coach at Arsenal under Mikel Arteta, joined Parma in 2025, taking on his first senior managerial role on a two-year contract after replacing Cristian Chivu, now manager of Inter Milan. "It has been an intense year and a half during which I gave my all, right up until the very last day, for a team and a club to which I have become deeply attached," Cuesta wrote on Instagram. The decision came a week after Parma secured their first victory of the Serie A season, beating Genoa 2-1 at home. Parma are currently 15th in the Serie A standings. "We were a united family that fought until the very last minute to achieve what we always wanted: to win," Cuesta added. Parma said Monday's training session would be led by the club's coaching staff pending further developments regarding the appointment of a new head coach.

item.title: Huracán Polo, de categoría 3, amenaza la costa de México; se espera que toque tierra el lunes
item.description: El huracán Polo, que se ha debilitado hasta convertirse en una tormenta de categoría 3, tocaria tierra en la costa del Pacífico de Baja California Sur el lunes por la noche, trayendo consigo vientos sostenidos de entre 95 y 130 kilómetros por hora y fuertes lluvias al popular destino turístico, informaron los meteorólogos.
item.dc:creator: Emily Green
item.content:encoded: El huracán Polo, que se ha debilitado hasta convertirse en una tormenta de categoría 3, tocaria tierra en la costa del Pacífico de Baja California Sur el lunes por la noche, trayendo consigo vientos sostenidos de entre 95 y 130 kilómetros por hora y fuertes lluvias al popular destino turístico, informaron los meteorólogos. En la mañana del domingo, el huracán se encontraba a unos 320 kilómetros de la costa de Baja California, desplazándose hacia el nor-noroeste a 19 kilómetros por hora con vientos sostenidos de 200 kilómetros, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos. La firma privada de pronósticos AccuWeather señaló que se espera que Polo se debilite gradualmente antes de tocar tierra como huracán de categoría 1; aunque aún podría derribar árboles y líneas eléctricas, así como causar daños estructurales. Las fuertes lluvias, el elevado oleaje y los vientos intensos ya han provocado evacuaciones, el cierre de puertos y la suspensión de clases a lo largo de la costa mexicana del Pacífico. En la ciudad turística de San José del Cabo, las autoridades restringieron el acceso a las playas debido a que la tormenta generaba grandes olas y un oleaje peligroso. Se pronostica que Polo dejará entre 4 y 8 pulgadas de lluvia en Baja California, incrementando el riesgo de inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra potencialmente mortales, antes de cruzar el Golfo de California y adentrarse en los estados norteños de Sonora y Chihuahua.

item.title: Russian attacks kills three in Ukrainian cities, strikes hit Kyiv districts, officials say
item.description: Russia also struck different districts of the Kyiv, local officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian attacks killed three people in two different Ukrainian cities on Sunday and struck different districts of the capital Kyiv, local officials said. Russian forces have long staged intensive attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, mostly at night, but in recent weeks they have launched strikes almost continuously throughout the day. In the northern city of Sumy, a frequent Russian target near the border, three glide bombs struck near a family support centre, killing two people, regional governor Oleh Hryhorov wrote on Telegram. Russia has long said it intends to turn areas of the Sumy region into a buffer zone. In Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city in the northeast and another frequent target, a drone struck a car, killing the driver, prosecutors said. And in Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a drone had struck a high-rise apartment building and triggered a fire in an eastern suburb, wounding one person. Emergency crews extinguished the blaze. Drones hit areas near a kindergarten and a playground in two districts, Klitschko said, and other areas in the city also suffered damage, though no casualties were reported. Both sides in the more than 4-1/2-year-old war deny targeting civilians.

item.title: Rússia ataca maior operadora de telefonia móvel da Ucrânia e atinge data centers
item.description: A Rússia atacou neste domingo a sede da Kyivstar, maior operadora de telefonia móvel da Ucrânia, informou a empresa à mídia local, enquanto Moscou seguia com bombardeios a data centers e infraestrutura de comunicações ucranianos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Rússia atacou neste domingo a sede da Kyivstar, maior operadora de telefonia móvel da Ucrânia, informou a empresa à mídia local, enquanto Moscou seguia com bombardeios a data centers e infraestrutura de comunicações ucranianos. A Kyivstar informou à agência de notícias Interfax Ucrânia que sua sede em Kiev havia sido atingida, mas não houve vítimas. O Ministério da Defesa da Rússia também informou neste domingo que atingiu um data center pertencente à Vodafone Ucrânia, segunda maior operadora de telefonia celular do país. A Vodafone Ucrânia não respondeu a um pedido de comentário. O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou que a Rússia atacou um data center em Kiev duas vezes na manhã deste domingo, ferindo duas crianças e um adulto. Moscou também atingiu data centers pertencentes a provedores de internet ucranianos na semana passada, causando interrupções no serviço para cerca de 100 mil residências em Kiev e na região circundante, de acordo com o Ministério Digital da Ucrânia. “A Rússia tem como alvo os principais data centers ucranianos, buscando interromper o fluxo de informações. Alertas rápidos sobre ameaças de mísseis e drones são essenciais -- eles salvam vidas”, escreveu o ministro das Relações Exteriores da Ucrânia, Andrii Sybiha, no X na quarta-feira.

item.title: Category 3 Hurricane Polo threatens Mexico’s coast, landfall expected Monday
item.description: Forecasters said Hurricane Polo, which has weakened to a Category 3 storm, is expected to make landfall on the Pacific coast of Baja California Sur on Monday night, bringing sustained winds of 60 to 80 mph and heavy rain to the popular tourist destination.
item.dc:creator: Emily Green
item.content:encoded: Forecasters said Hurricane Polo, which has weakened to a Category 3 storm, is expected to make landfall on the Pacific coast of Baja California Sur on Monday night, bringing sustained winds of 60 to 80 mph and heavy rain to the popular tourist destination. As of 11 a.m. EDT on Sunday, the hurricane was about 200 miles off the Baja California coast, moving north-northwest at 12 mph with sustained winds of 125 mph, according to the US National Hurricane Center. Private forecaster AccuWeather said Polo is expected to gradually weaken before making landfall as a Category 1 hurricane, but could still topple trees and power lines and inflict structural damage. Heavy rain, high surf and strong winds have already prompted evacuations, port closures and school cancellations along Mexico's Pacific coast. In the resort city of San Jose del Cabo, authorities restricted access to beaches as the storm churned up large waves and dangerous surf. Polo is forecast to dump 4 to 8 inches (10 to 20 cm) of rain across Baja California, raising the risk of life-threatening flooding and mudslides, before crossing the Gulf of California and moving into the northern states of Sonora and Chihuahua.

item.title: Papa exorta Igreja a enfrentar suas falhas antes de se reunir com vítimas de abuso na França
item.description: O papa Leão exortou a Igreja Católica neste domingo a reconhecer suas próprias falhas e a sanar as “feridas profundas” infligidas em suas fileiras, poucas horas antes de se reunir com vítimas de abusos cometidos por padres na França.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão exortou a Igreja Católica neste domingo a reconhecer suas próprias falhas e a sanar as “feridas profundas” infligidas em suas fileiras, poucas horas antes de se reunir com vítimas de abusos cometidos por padres na França. Dirigindo-se a uma multidão que se estendia por um grande campo próximo ao famoso santuário católico de Lourdes, Leão disse que a Igreja deve ter a coragem de encarar seu passado, mas não fez referência direta aos escândalos de abuso na França que causaram comoção em todo o país. “Para curar as feridas profundas, as infidelidades e os erros dolorosos que ocorreram dentro (da Igreja), devemos humildemente nos colocar sob o olhar purificador do Senhor”, disse o primeiro papa norte-americano a cerca de 150 mil pessoas reunidas no campo em um dia ensolarado. Leão faz uma visita relâmpago de quatro dias a três cidades na França, onde mais uma vez fez um apelo para que o mundo reconsidere o desenvolvimento da inteligência artificial. Ele atraiu cerca de 800 mil pessoas para uma missa ao ar livre nos Champs-Élysées, em Paris, no sábado. Líderes da Igreja local esperam que ele ajude a restaurar a reputação da instituição após um relatório de 2021 revelar que cerca de 330 mil crianças francesas foram vítimas de abuso por parte de clérigos católicos e líderes leigos ao longo de sete décadas. Em uma reunião anterior a portas fechadas com os bispos franceses neste domingo, Leão se referiu diretamente ao “doloroso flagelo dos abusos cometidos contra menores por membros do clero”, segundo um texto divulgado pelo Vaticano. O papa agradeceu aos bispos pelas “medidas corajosas” que, segundo ele, foram tomadas para enfrentar os escândalos. Leão os incentivou a redobrar seus esforços de proteção e a “continuar no caminho trilhado, mantendo a máxima vigilância”. CETICISMO Leão já havia se desculpado diretamente pelos escândalos de abuso que prejudicaram a credibilidade da Igreja em todo o mundo. Em uma viagem à Espanha em junho, ele disse aos bispos locais que eles deveriam ouvir as vítimas e oferecer-lhes reparações. O papa deve se reunir a portas fechadas com sete vítimas francesas de abuso por parte do clero ainda neste domingo. Alguns sobreviventes disseram duvidar que o encontro resulte em mudanças rápidas por parte da Igreja. “Estou bastante cética quanto à possibilidade de o papa resolver a questão, pelo menos não imediatamente”, disse à Reuters Michèle Le Reun-Gaigné, copresidente de uma associação de sobreviventes no oeste da França. “As coisas estão avançando muito lentamente”, disse ela. “Isso não vai acontecer da noite para o dia.” O bispo Pierre-Antoine Bozo, porta-voz dos bispos franceses, afirmou que o desejo do papa de realizar o encontro “mostra que não podemos ignorar essa questão e que ela deve permanecer sempre entre nossas preocupações”. A agenda do papa na França inclui seis eventos em Lourdes, uma cidade no sopé dos Pirineus que atrai cerca de 3 milhões de peregrinos por ano para visitas a um santuário dedicado à Virgem Maria e às supostas águas curativas da fonte. O local também está ligado a um escândalo que tem atormentado o Vaticano nos últimos anos. A fachada do santuário exibe uma série de mosaicos do padre Marko Rupnik, um proeminente artista religioso com laços com o Vaticano, que foi acusado de abuso sexual. Rupnik, acusado por mais de 20 mulheres, não teria se pronunciado publicamente sobre as acusações. Cinco mulheres que o acusam escreveram uma carta aberta ao papa na quinta-feira, criticando duramente o julgamento do clérigo em andamento no Vaticano. Os mosaicos, que se estendem por vários andares, foram cobertos para a visita do papa com grandes lonas amarelas de tom suave. Ao chegar para a missa neste domingo, Leão foi conduzido em seu papamóvel aberto até perto da fachada do santuário e dos mosaicos cobertos. O papa, que na sexta-feira reiterou com veemência a oposição católica às iniciativas de morte assistida -- dois meses após a França criar o direito legal de morrer para pessoas com doenças incuráveis --, mencionou novamente a postura pró-vida da Igreja em Lourdes. Ao se reunir com voluntários que ajudam peregrinos doentes na esperança de encontrar um milagre nas águas do santuário, Leão os instou a se lembrarem do “profundo significado” do trabalho na área da saúde. “Isso significa cuidar de uma pessoa que sofre, não eliminá-la”, disse o papa. “A medicina nunca deve se tornar serva da morte programada!”

item.title: Team Europe cruise past Team World to win sixth Laver Cup title
item.description: World number two Alexander Zverev sealed Team Europe's record-extending title.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World number two Alexander Zverev sealed Team Europe's record-extending sixth Laver Cup title with a straight-sets victory over American Learner Tien, giving them a 13-5 win against Team World at London's O2 Arena on Sunday. Team Europe, captained by Yannick Noah, entered the third and final day needing two victories to reclaim the trophy. Sunday's matches were worth three points each, with the first team to reach 13 points claiming the Laver Cup. Match wins were worth one point on Friday and two points on Saturday. French Open runner-up Flavio Cobolli of Italy teamed up with Czech Jakub Mensik to open the final day's action, moving Team Europe to within one win of the title after a 7-5 6-3 victory over Team World's Taylor Fritz and Alex de Minaur that extended their lead to 10-5. French Open and US Open champion Zverev then took centre stage against Tien, with the German prevailing 7-6(3) 6-3 to seal the title for Europe. PLAYERS SING ON COURT TO CELEBRATE The victory marked the fourth time Zverev had helped to clinch the Laver Cup for Team Europe. He also secured the winning points in Chicago in 2018, Geneva in 2019, and in Boston in 2021 when he won the doubles alongside Russian Andrey Rublev. Zverev's victory sparked jubilant celebrations, with the European players leaping in celebration and singing on court. "I'm happy that I did it today," Zverev said. "But massive credit to the entire Team World. They pushed us all the way. "I think we had a great team, great team chemistry and a great team effort. We're definitely happy that we won!" Seven-times Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz, who returned at Flushing Meadows after a lengthy layoff due to a wrist injury and has looked sharp since, had been scheduled to face Australian De Minaur in a later singles match. Rising 20-year-old Spaniard Rafael Jodar was due to play Fritz, but neither match was needed after Zverev wrapped up the contest. "We had three chances to close it out in the singles," Zverev added. "Especially with Carlos playing after me, I think that gives me a lot of confidence and gives me a little bit of freedom to play. "But still, it was an incredibly tough match. Credit to Learner as well. "I think Carlos is also very happy that I closed it out. And me too, by the way! I'm very happy that I won." Hollywood star Leonardo DiCaprio and Swiss tennis great Roger Federer, a co-founder and co-owner of the Laver Cup, were among the spectators at a packed O2 Arena. Team World is made up of players from continents outside Europe. The annual tournament, which began in 2017, is intended to be tennis' equivalent of golf's Ryder Cup. Team Europe lifted the trophy in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021 and 2024 before adding this year's crown, while Team World won the title in 2022, 2023 and 2025. The 2027 edition, which will mark the tournament's 10th staging, will be held at the Intuit Dome in Inglewood, California.

item.title: Era ends for Giants as Dodgers roll on to postseason
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers will look to tarnish the final game of longtime San Francisco Giants broadcaster Mike Krukow's career with a 100th regular-season win when the California rivals wrap up the regular season on Sunday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Dodgers will look to tarnish the final game of longtime San Francisco Giants broadcaster Mike Krukow's career with a 100th regular-season win when the California rivals wrap up the regular season on Sunday afternoon. The finale in San Francisco will send the Dodgers (99-62) on their quest for a third consecutive World Series championship and Krukow into retirement after 36 years of calling Giants games. Also a pitcher for the Giants for the final seven of his 14 seasons in the majors, Krukow, 74, will be honored after Sunday's game, in which the home team will seek to end a four-game losing streak overall and a seven-game skid against the Dodgers. "I'm going to tell them just how much they mean to me and my family," Krukow promised this week about his farewell speech. "I don't know if you can convey it in words, but it'll be conveyed in emotion. That I can guarantee." Krukow was in the booth when San Francisco won three World Series titles in five seasons from 2010-14, but the team has been to the postseason just twice since then (2016, 2021), losing both times in the National League Division Series. This season, the Giants (65-96) will finish with their fewest wins in a full season since going 64-98 in 2017. Meanwhile, the Dodgers will wind up with more wins than the 98 they had in 2024 and 93 last season, regular seasons followed by World Series victories. This will be their 14th consecutive appearance in the postseason; they also won the World Series in the pandemic-shortened season in 2020. With a first-round bye to start their three-peat effort as a result of having the second-best record in the National League, the Dodgers will need 11 wins to achieve a first in Major League Baseball since the Yankees captured the World Series in 1998, 1999 and 2000. Los Angeles saw a lot go right in its first two games in San Francisco -- both victories -- as they got home runs from Teoscar Hernandez, Andy Pages, Enrique Hernandez and Mookie Betts, sharp starting pitching from Tarik Skubal and Blake Snell, and stellar game-closing from Tanner Scott. The Dodgers will take the field Sunday with postseason roster spots still up for grabs and pitchers needing one more outing before a five-day break leading into a best-of-five NLDS, which will open in Los Angeles on Saturday. "We want to finish playing good baseball," Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters. "Our guys still got to get ready because we've got a week of not playing baseball. So (the goal is) just to finish strong, finish the season out." One unresolved issue for Los Angeles in the postseason is who will bat leadoff. Shohei Ohtani, who manned the spot almost exclusively while healthy earlier in the season, led off Friday's 2-0 win over the Giants, going 0-for-4 with three strikeouts. Roberts moved Betts into the top spot for Saturday's 4-3 victory, and while Betts went just 1-for-5 with a strikeout, his hit was his 23rd home run of the season. Ohtani, who singled and struck out twice while slotted second on Saturday, has gone just 4-for-18 with just one extra-base hit, a double, since returning from a 16-day absence due to discomfort in his right biceps. While the Dodgers have not announced a starting pitcher for Sunday's game, the Giants will send right-hander Carson Seymour (0-2, 4.70 ERA) to the mound as an opener. He will make his first start after 24 relief appearances this season. Seymour does not have a decision in five career outings against the Dodgers. He has a 3.60 ERA, allowing two runs in five innings. He pitched the sixth inning on Saturday, striking out one. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bill Gates joins calls for AI safeguards, including legislation
item.description: "No one things self-regulation is enough," he said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: AI requires safeguards that go beyond self-regulation, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates said in an interview that aired on Sunday, calling for legislation to be passed in Congress. "You need law enforcement and the politicians to get into the discussion about what safeguards and monitoring look like," Gates said in a taped interview on NBC's "Meet the Press" program. "And that has to be a required thing." A sudden groundswell has risen in favor of federal intervention after OpenAI [USN:L6N43Q12M TEXT:"said in July"] that an autonomous AI agent went rogue during a security test and hacked into another company, subverting human control. Gates joined that chorus, saying that government must be involved. "No one thinks self-regulation is enough," he said. In a rare show of unity, the CEOs of rivals Anthropic, OpenAI, Google’s (GOOGL.O) DeepMind, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and xAI have called for slowing the development of increasingly capable AI systems. But US President Donald Trump and other opponents of additional regulation for AI say new government restrictions would simply give China the upper hand in the AI revolution. Trump has publicly dismissed calls for new laws on AI [USN:L1N4560HH TEXT:"as a "hoax.""] Gates argued that safeguards would not dramatically hinder the industry, and that the risks of not implementing them are real. "It's not a hoax at all," he told NBC. Gates has said he wants to meet Trump to discuss AI. "I hope that, given my life's work in the field, my saying how unique and different this is and how concerned I am will add to what he's hearing from other people," Gates said. Axios reported that Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei will have dinner on Sunday with Trump at the White House. Anthropic and the White House did not immediately return a request for comment on the Axios report. Warnings about AI's risks are not new. But they took on added urgency this month after researchers in leading AI labs attached both a timeline and a probability to those concerns. Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned that AI could kill us all by the end of the decade, prompting US lawmakers to [USN:L6N4520JB TEXT:"call for new rules"] to govern the technology. Evan Hubinger, Anthropic's alignment science lead, echoed Coxon's warning, saying there was a more than 10% chance of such an event within the next decade. Some policymakers have proposed mandating a "[USN:L6N43P10V TEXT:"kill switch"]" that would allow federal authorities to halt AI models. Gates said that while he was not opposed to some sort of kill switch, it would not be enough if other safeguards were not also implemented. The US and China agreed to launch a [USN:AZN4TK3M7 TEXT:"dialogue on AI"] following President Xi Jinping's recent visit to Washington.

item.title: Irã insiste em solução diplomática após Trump rejeitar plano de paz
item.description: O Irã insistiu neste domingo que somente a diplomacia pode resolver seu conflito com os Estados Unidos e Israel, após o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmar que rejeitou uma proposta iraniana para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz e encerrar os combates.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: O Irã insistiu neste domingo que somente a diplomacia pode resolver seu conflito com os Estados Unidos e Israel, após o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmar que rejeitou uma proposta iraniana para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz e encerrar os combates. “Nossas condições são claras, e qualquer medida para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz depende do cumprimento dessas condições”, postou o ministro das Relações Exteriores iraniano, Abbas Araqchi, nas redes sociais. “Somente uma solução negociada pode tirar as partes desse impasse.” O Irã anunciou uma proposta de paz na semana passada na Assembleia Geral da ONU, em Nova York, afirmando que ela havia sido transmitida aos norte-americanos por meio de mediadores do Catar. Trump disse no sábado que rejeitou o plano e argumentou que o desespero estava levando os iranianos a pressionarem por um acordo sobre a importante via navegável. “Eles querem fechar um acordo para abrir o Estreito de Ormuz imediatamente porque estão perdendo feio”, disse Trump a jornalistas na Casa Branca. Apesar das declarações públicas de Trump, mediadores que facilitam as negociações de Teerã com Washington não transmitiram oficialmente uma rejeição dos EUA ao plano, disse Araqchi. “Estamos aguardando que os mediadores nos transmitam as posições definitivas, e tomaremos uma decisão com base nelas”, postou Araqchi. Os EUA impuseram um bloqueio econômico ao Irã para pressionar Teerã a interromper os ataques iranianos a embarcações no Estreito de Ormuz, o que reduziu drasticamente o tráfego marítimo na região, mesmo com Trump afirmando repetidamente que os EUA controlam a via navegável. O comandante-chefe do exército iraniano, Amir Hatam, disse que a guerra está em uma fase crítica e decisiva, acrescentando que Teerã não vai aceitar uma situação em que não possa comercializar enquanto potências estrangeiras utilizam as vias navegáveis estratégicas da região. “Se o Irã não puder comercializar, se o Irã não puder viver, ninguém poderá comercializar ou viver”, disse, em declarações divulgadas pela mídia estatal. ARÁBIA SAUDITA Tentativas anteriores de diplomacia não tiveram sucesso em encerrar a guerra, iniciada em 28 de fevereiro com ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã. Desde então, o conflito tem alternado entre pausas e novos ataques, matando milhares de pessoas, enfraquecendo as forças convencionais do Irã e prejudicando sua já debilitada economia. O Irã e seus aliados responderam expandindo o conflito por toda a região. O Irã atacou aliados dos EUA no Golfo com drones e mísseis, enquanto seus aliados houthis no Iêmen atacaram alvos sauditas. A Arábia Saudita, o maior dos países do Golfo, foi arrastada ainda mais para a guerra neste mês, à medida que combatentes houthis avançaram no Iêmen, derrotando as forças do governo apoiado pela Arábia Saudita e ameaçando as exportações sauditas de petróleo pelo Mar Vermelho. Apoiados pelo Irã, os houthis têm disparado repetidamente contra a Arábia Saudita e, em um possível sinal de mais uma escalada, pais em Riade receberam avisos das escolas neste domingo informando que as aulas passariam a ser ministradas remotamente durante a semana, segundo pessoas que receberam as mensagens. O aviso não apresentou o motivo da decisão. Autoridades sauditas não responderam imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Enquanto isso, o Ministério da Saúde do Iêmen, controlado pelos houthis, informou que sete pessoas morreram e 40 ficaram feridas, incluindo crianças, em um ataque a lojas em um mercado no cruzamento de Mawiya, na província de Taiz, no sudoeste do país. Posteriormente, o governo do Iêmen, reconhecido internacionalmente, informou que suas forças haviam atacado um acampamento militar houthi e veículos no mesmo cruzamento.

item.title: South Korea voices regret over Ukraine denial of pact on North Korean PoWs, Yonhap reports
item.description: South Korea's presidential office expressed "strong regret" on Sunday over what it described as Ukraine's denial of an agreement with Seoul not to disclose the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea, Yonhap News Agency reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea's presidential office expressed "strong regret" on Sunday over what it described as Ukraine's denial of an agreement with Seoul not to disclose the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea, Yonhap News Agency reported. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy told the United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday that Ukraine had transferred [USN:L1N45G00G TEXT:"two captured North Korean soldiers"] to South Korea. He saying the men had recently been sent there after being captured while fighting for Russia in the war against Ukraine. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung later said it was "deeply regretful" that Ukraine had made the transfer public, adding that the two sides had agreed not to disclose it. The presidential office "expresses strong regret over Ukraine's unilateral disclosure (of the transfer) and its subsequent false announcement that there had not been a non-disclosure agreement," Yonhap quoted Seong Ghi-hong, senior presidential secretary for public relations, as saying in a statement. The South Korean official added that the government was considering additional measures over the issue if necessary, Yonhap added. Ukraine captured the two North Koreans in Russia's Kursk region in January 2025. They were the first North Korean soldiers to be captured alive since Pyongyang entered the Russia-Ukraine war in 2024. The transfer comes as South Korea has backed efforts to revive dialogue with North Korea, while US President Donald Trump has renewed his willingness to engage with Pyongyang.

item.title: China weighs allowing ByteDance, Alibaba to buy new Nvidia chips, The Information reports
item.description: The Chinese government has signaled it could allow some domestic companies like ByteDance and Alibaba to buy Nvidia's chip built for high-end professional computers, The Information reported on Sunday, citing two people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Chinese government has signaled it could allow some domestic companies like ByteDance and Alibaba (9988.HK) to buy Nvidia's (NVDA.O) chip built for high-end professional computers, The Information reported on Sunday, citing two people familiar with the matter. China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently asked companies including ByteDance and Alibaba to report their plans to purchase Nvidia's RTX PRO 5500 chips, according to the report. The ministry told some Chinese companies the government intends to approve the purchases, The Information report said, adding some industry executives expect the RTX PRO 5500 chip to avoid US export restrictions. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. "US firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated US export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly a half a decade ago, and China's own limits on US imports," an Nvidia spokesperson said, when asked to comment on the report. Alibaba and ByteDance did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. Reuters was not immediately able to contact the Chinese government for comment.

item.title: Report: Rams' Myles Garrett faces 6-week recovery from knee surgery
item.description: Los Angeles Rams star defensive end Myles Garrett is expected to be sidelined approximately six weeks in his recovery from knee surgery, NFL Network reported Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Rams star defensive end Myles Garrett is expected to be sidelined approximately six weeks in his recovery from knee surgery, NFL Network reported Sunday. Garrett officially was placed on injured reserve on Sept. 17, one week after Los Angeles' season-opening 27-7 loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Melbourne, Australia. Given the timeline, Garrett could return for the Rams' game against the host Washington Commanders on Nov. 8. Los Angeles head coach Sean McVay is on record as saying that the team is "not going to rush him back." Garrett, 30, broke the NFL single-season sack record last season with 23 en route to being named as the 2025 NFL Defensive Player of the Year. He is the first player in NFL history (since sacks started being recorded in 1982) to notch at least 12 sacks in six straight seasons (2020-25). He is third among active players in career sacks (125.5) behind Von Miller (138.5) and Cameron Jordan (132). The Rams acquired Garrett from the Cleveland Browns on June 1 for outside linebacker Jared Verse, a 2027 first-round pick, a 2028 second-round selection and a 2029 conditional third-round pick. --Field Level Media

item.title: Reports: Bears QB Caleb Williams likely out 3-4 weeks
item.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is expected to be sidelined for three to four weeks with a Grade 2 hamstring injury, multiple media outlets reported Sunday morning.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is expected to be sidelined for three to four weeks with a Grade 2 hamstring injury, multiple media outlets reported Sunday morning. The reports, however, noted that Williams could return sooner than that timeline, with head coach Ben Johnson saying earlier this week that the quarterback has been known as a quick healer. Williams has been ruled out for the Monday night game pitting the Bears (1-1) against the visiting Philadelphia Eagles (2-0). Backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared the necessary steps in the concussion protocol to participate in practice on Saturday, Johnson said. Bagent was a full participant in the session and is listed as questionable to play on Monday. Third-string quarterback Case Keenum, who made his NFL debut in 2013, would be in line to start if Bagent is not cleared. Williams sustained a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of Chicago's 9-3 loss to the Minnesota Vikings last Sunday. He sat out his third straight practice session on Saturday. Should Williams sit out three games, he'd be in line to return against the host Atlanta Falcons on Oct. 18. The New England Patriots will visit the Bears the following week. Williams, 24, made 36 consecutive regular-season starts since the Bears drafted him No. 1 overall in 2024. He has completed 65.5% of his passes for 407 yards, two touchdowns and one interception this season for Chicago. --Field Level Media

item.title: Polícia do Reino Unido prende cinco pessoas em base aérea sob lei antiterrorismo
item.description: A polícia britânica informou que agentes da unidade antiterrorismo estão liderando investigações para apurar uma ocorrência em uma base aérea utilizada pela Força Aérea dos Estados Unidos neste domingo, após prenderem cinco homens sob suspeita de estarem preparando um ato terrorista.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia britânica informou que agentes da unidade antiterrorismo estão liderando investigações para apurar uma ocorrência em uma base aérea utilizada pela Força Aérea dos Estados Unidos neste domingo, após prenderem cinco homens sob suspeita de estarem preparando um ato terrorista. Os cinco homens também foram detidos sob suspeita de terem cometido infrações previstas na Lei de Explosivos.

item.title: Italy dominate to win America's Cup run-up regatta in Naples
item.description: Italy wrapped up the three-day preliminary America's Cup regatta in Naples on Sunday with a convincing head-to-head match-race final win over holders New Zealand.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Smith
item.content:encoded: Italy wrapped up the three-day preliminary America's Cup regatta in Naples on Sunday with a convincing head-to-head match-race final win over [USN:L6N4050UK TEXT:"holders New Zealand"]. Although the outcome does not affect the standings for the America's Cup itself in Naples next summer, it gives a glimpse of how the teams are progressing in their race preparations. [USN:L4N40F01M TEXT:"Italy"] led off the start in Sunday's two-boat final, with the two crews opting for opposite sides of the Bay of Naples course. As New Zealand battled to get back in the race after a slower start, the Italian [USN:L8N41Y2GC TEXT:"AC40 foiling yacht"] countered to stay ahead, covering their every move. The four-member Italian crew and their support team celebrated, surrounded by a flotilla of spectator boats, as the sun sparkled on the waters off Naples. The final pitted the two crews with the highest score after eight fleet races featuring crews from Italy and New Zealand alongside [USN:L8N3YL0O9 TEXT:"Britain"], [USN:L6N4050UK TEXT:"France"], Switzerland and the [USN:L6N4470GK TEXT:"United States"]. Next year's competition to lift the America's Cup, which dates back to 1851 and is known as the "Auld Mug", will see the national teams compete in bigger AC75 yachts. The one-design AC40s will be used in both the women's and youth events next summer. [USN:L1N41Q14C TEXT:"Australia"], who made a late America's Cup entry in May, did not field a crew in Naples, where teams have already begun setting up their bases on the coast in nearby [USN:L8N40714N TEXT:"Bagnoli"], which local authorities are regenerating to host the event.

Sept 27 : Italy wrapped up the three-day preliminary America's Cup regatta in Naples on Sunday with a convincing head-to-head match-race final win over holders New Zealand. Although the outcome does not affect the standings for the America's Cup itself in Naples next summer, it gives a glimpse of how the teams are progressing in their race preparations. Italy led off the start in Sunday's two-boat final, with the two crews opting for opposite sides of the Bay of Naples course. As New Zealand battled to get back in the race after a slower start, the Italian AC40 foiling yacht countered to stay ahead, covering their every move.

The four-member Italian crew and their support team celebrated, surrounded by a flotilla of spectator boats, as the sun sparkled on the waters off Naples. The final pitted the two crews with the highest score after eight fleet races featuring crews from Italy and New Zealand alongside Britain, France, Switzerland and the United States. Next year's competition to lift the America's Cup, which dates back to 1851 and is known as the "Auld Mug", will see the national teams compete in bigger AC75 yachts. The one-design AC40s will be used in both the women's and youth events next summer. Australia, who made a late America's Cup entry in May, did not field a crew in Naples, where teams have already begun setting up their bases on the coast in nearby Bagnoli, which local authorities are regenerating to host the event.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Russia says it struck military infrastructure, vessels in Ukraine
item.description: The Russian defence ministry said on Sunday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on logistics centres, port and transport infrastructure, as well as communications centres and vessels that Moscow said were linked to the Ukrainian military.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Russian defence ministry said on Sunday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on logistics centres, port and transport infrastructure, as well as communications centres and vessels that Moscow said were linked to the Ukrainian military. The ministry said the strikes hit a data centre in Kyiv, logistic hubs in the Kyiv and Odesa regions, two drone storages in Mykolaiv, the headquarters of a naval base as well as of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine and military stores in Kiliya port. A cargo ship carrying military and dual-use goods to the port of Odesa was also struck, it said. The ministry said later on Sunday that it had carried out another series of strikes during the day hitting two data centres in Kyiv, a logistic hub in Odesa, as well as another cargo vessel headed for Odesa. Reuters could not independently verify the claims. Kyivstar, Ukraine's largest mobile service provider, told local media [USN:L1N45J046 TEXT:"on Sunday"] its head office had been struck but there were no casualties.

item.title: Angels hope to retain unique distinction in finale vs. Mariners
item.description: Only one active franchise in Major League Baseball has never had a 100-loss season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Only one active franchise in Major League Baseball has never had a 100-loss season. That distinction will be on the line for the Los Angeles Angels (62-99) when they wrap up the season Sunday afternoon against the host Seattle Mariners (75-86). The Angels, who started play in 1961, tied a team record for most franchise losses in a season, set in 2024, with Saturday's 8-4 loss to the Mariners. "We're trying to go out there and win, obviously," Angels manager Kurt Suzuki said. "We know (100 losses) has been talked about over the last few weeks. But (Sunday), we're going to come here and be ready to play." Bryce Teodosio hit a two-RBI single in a four-run sixth inning Saturday as the Angels rallied from a 4-0 deficit. Mariners pinch hitter Taylor Ward, who spent his first eight MLB seasons with the Angels before splitting this season between Baltimore and Seattle, hit a tiebreaking, two-run single in the seventh inning. J.P. Crawford hit a two-run homer on the next pitch from Mitch Farris to send the Angels to the loss. The Mariners got a scare in the fourth inning when prized prospect Kade Anderson took a 103.8-mph line drive by the Angels' Christian Moore off his pitching arm. "I thought the worst," Mariners manager Dan Wilson said. "Certainly, watching him kind of react and then kind of holding his arm down. I thought maybe something had broken or whatever." Anderson was diagnosed with a bruised left forearm and after the game showed the seam marks left by the ball. "It got me pretty good," said Anderson, who pitched 3 1/3 scoreless innings, with four hits and one walk allowed and four strikeouts. "It's not a great feeling by any means." Anderson, the third overall pick in the 2025 draft out of LSU, went 2-2 with a 3.79 ERA in seven starts since being recalled from Double-A Arkansas. "That's the beauty of the offseason," the 22-year-old said. "You get to take a look back at what happened this season, and I just feel like there's a lot of improvement for me going into this offseason. I've learned a lot of things that going into next season will be very beneficial." The Angels on Sunday will start veteran left-hander Yusei Kikuchi (1-6, 4.88 ERA), who spent his first three seasons with the Mariners from 2019-21. The Mariners will counter with right-hander Logan Gilbert (12-11, 3.81), their Opening Day starter. Kikuchi didn't get a decision in a 9-7 loss to the Athletics on Tuesday in West Sacramento, Calif., in a game in which he gave up two runs on seven hits over 5 1/ 3 innings. In his start before that, on Sept. 16, he suffered a 7-2 loss to the visiting Mariners as he allowed five runs (four earned) over 4 1/3 innings, on five hits and five walks. Kikuchi is 1-3 despite a 2.11 ERA in seven career starts against Seattle. Gilbert has dropped his past two starts. He was tagged for four runs on a season-high 10 hits over four innings Tuesday in a 7-0 loss to the visiting Houston Astros. He pitched well Sept. 15 in Anaheim, Calif., but was beaten 2-1 by the Angels despite a quality start. Gilbert is 4-5 with a 3.84 ERA in 12 career starts vs. the Angels. --Field Level Media

item.title: Armani unveils shimmering collection in pursuit of 'evolution'
item.description: Giorgio Armani presented a womenswear collection on Sunday that combined its trademark tailoring with shimmering fabrics, as the Italian luxury group navigates a transition period a year after the death of its founder.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Giorgio Armani presented a womenswear collection on Sunday that combined its trademark tailoring with shimmering fabrics, as the Italian luxury group navigates a transition period a year after the death of its founder. Titled "Evolution", the new collection by Silvana Armani – the late designer's niece – featured a palette of ivory, black and gold and showcased eighties-inspired sharp-shoulder jackets with knee-length trousers, bold geometries and body-skimming evening gowns. "Style is a way of being, rather than an immutable code: the ability to change while remaining true to oneself," the group said in notes to accompany its runway show at Teatro Armani, one of the group's headquarters buildings in Milan. Noting that "identity can evolve", it added that the butterflies featured on brooches and necklaces symbolised metamorphosis. Speaking to reporters after the show, Silvana Armani reaffirmed she was committed to continuity with the brand's aesthetic while allowing room for an "evolution", pointing to the introduction of cotton as an example of change. The Italian fashion house is entering a [USN:L8N44P155 TEXT:"pivotal period"] as the clock starts ticking on plans to sell an initial 15% stake to outside investors. CEO Giuseppe [USN:L8N45J02L TEXT:"Marsocci said"] the group was open to multiple investors in the share sale, adding that no decision had been made. Earlier this month, the group named [USN:L8N4580KP TEXT:"Dario Vitale"] creative director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani accessories, marking the first time someone from outside the Armani family has taken on that role.

item.title: Tigers, Pirates finish season one day after Justin Verlander's emotional final game
item.description: He didn't pick up the win, but the final game of his career on Saturday was a big triumph for Detroit's Justin Verlander.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: He didn't pick up the win, but the final game of his career on Saturday was a big triumph for Detroit's Justin Verlander. The 43-year-old right-hander, making just his second start of the season due to injuries, went 5 1/3 innings and gave up just two solo home runs in his 557th career start. Just for good measure, rookie Eduardo Valencia hit a walk-off, two-run home run with two outs in the ninth inning to give the Tigers a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Detroit (76-85) will go for a sweep on Sunday afternoon on the last day of the season. The Pirates (81-80) need to win to finish above .500 for the first time since 2018. Verlander retired the first batter in the sixth inning, and Tigers manager A.J. Hinch sent Verlander's 7-year-old daughter, Genevieve, to the mound to take him out of the game. "I didn't imagine how things would play out," Verlander said. "I had no clue how my game would go. I really hoped to get five innings. The way it played out -- with Genevieve, running out to the mound -- man, that really hit me. "If I could be healthy on the field, I still got it, but I made two starts this year. So I revved my engine one more time. Overall, I felt I left it all out on the field." Valencia made sure Verlander didn't go out with the loss. "It was the last game for JV," said Valencia, who became the first rookie to hit a walk-off home run with the Tigers behind since Lou Whitaker in 1978. "I just wanted to make good contact, get a piece of the ball and tie the game up." The Tigers will send right-hander River Ryan (0-0, 0.00 ERA) to the mound for the season finale. The 28-year-old was the starter for the Tigers in a 9-2 win over the Washington Nationals on Monday. He is 1-0 with a 1.16 ERA in five career starts and has never faced Pittsburgh. The Pirates will counter with right-hander Jared Jones (5-6, 3.87 ERA), who is coming off an impressive win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Tuesday. The 25-year-old gave up one hit and no runs in seven innings, striking out nine, in a 2-0 victory. Jones is 11-14 with a 4.02 ERA in 42 career starts and is 1-0 with a 10.38 ERA in one start against the Tigers. But Verlander has been the story of the weekend. Pirates manager Don Kelly was the starting third baseman for Erie SeaWolves when Verlander made his first Double-A start in 2005. "He is a first-ballot Hall of Famer," said Kelly, who playfully asked the umpire to check the ball for a foreign substance during Saturday's start. "He is an elite competitor who is simply a winner." Verlander announced his retirement in July. He finished his 21-year major league career with a record of 266-159 and a 3.33 ERA, with 3,560 strikeouts over 3,576 2/3 innings. The three-time Cy Young Award winner is eighth on MLB's all-time strikeout list. He finished this season 0-1 with a 7.00 ERA. Kelly, meanwhile, emphasized that finishing above .500 matters greatly to the Pirates. It looked as if the Pirates had that finish secured most of Saturday when Brandon Lowe and Jacob Gonzalez homered off Verlander to stake Pittsburgh to a 2-0 early lead. Bryan Reynolds tripled in a run in the eighth to make it 3-1, but closer Mason Montgomery could not hold the lead in the ninth. It was only his third blown save of the season. He had converted 15 straight to give him 17 for the season heading into Saturday. --Field Level Media

item.title: UBSとの統合に複数の大手銀行が関心、少なくとも8社－スイス紙
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 複数の大手グローバル銀行がスイスのUBSグループに対し、統合の可能性に関心を示している。スイスの大衆紙ブリックが事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。
世界の大手金融機関少なくとも8社がUBSに対し、協議に応じる意向を示したと、関係者の1人は話したという。同紙は、こうした意向がいつ示されたのか、UBSに関心を示した金融機関名については明らかにしていない。
UBSの広報担当者は「この件に関する臆測や見解」についてはコメントしないと述べた。
スイス議会上院では今月、国内最大の銀行UBSに対し、外国子会社を支えるための自己資本をさらに積み増すよう義務付ける案について、過半数の議員が支持した。
ブルームバーグ・ニュースはこれまで、UBSが自己資本規制を過度に厳しいと判断した場合、スイス国外への本社移転も選択肢として検討してきたと報じている。
原題：UBS Has Attracted Interest
